data.body:
Carry-over from the agentic engine arm (Gerrit 3354, nickel-ferric-llama, merged fdf0a94aba8): LLM-Review +1 with 7 ADVISORY findings, deliberately not re-pushed (a new patch set would reset both votes). They touch code this adapter replaces or extends:
1. Stale comment in src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml above `engine_route` (~:58-62): it still says the route folds into ONE boolean and RAISES under agentic. The route now emits run_pipeline + run_agentic and never raises. Fix it when this story edits the agentic arm.
2. The post-dispatch tail is now gated on engine == "pipeline" only, so under "agentic" a Layer-1 floor BLOCK with 2+ DET blockers skips fix-unit grouping. That only drops stamps; verdict and findings are identical. Decide whether floor verdicts should get the tail under both engines.
3. A failed agent run degrades through `_degraded_plan_review_verdict` (gate_dispatch.py ~:285), which records no `engine` and reports llm_ran False. The epic wants a non-clean agentic run to record `engine` and the failure class on coverage, so stamp coverage.engine="agentic" on that path.
4. No test pins that plan_review_agentic_verdict stamps the verdict `model` with the frontier class the agent ran on.
5. test_prompt_is_packaged_and_free_of_bakeoff_placeholders asserts the prose "dollar amounts"; a wording check, not a contract.
6. The prompt `plan-review-agentic` declares no `outputs:` front matter for `plan_review_agentic_findings`, unlike other structured plan-review-pass prompts. That affects prompt_override validation; add `outputs: plan_review_agentic_findings`.
7. Same as 1, flagged as deletion impact.
